name: PageProtectPro
author: pageprotectpro

sections.description:
PageProtectPro is a focused WordPress password protection plugin for securing individual pages and posts, private content areas, or an entire website with a shared password.

Use PageProtectPro for client review websites, staging sites, staff resources, internal documents, private training materials, event pages, websites under construction and other WordPress content that should not be publicly available.

The plugin adds a clean visitor-facing password screen and keeps the setup inside WordPress, without requiring a membership system or coding.

See PageProtectPro in action

PageProtectPro Lite features

  • Password protect an entire WordPress website with one password
  • Password protect unlimited individual pages and posts
  • Set a separate password for each protected page or post
  • Allow selected logged-in WordPress roles to bypass protection
  • Customise the lock-screen title, message, labels and button text
  • Customise the lock-screen background and button colours
  • Open protection settings quickly from the WordPress Pages list
  • Review protected pages and their password status from one dashboard
  • Keep WordPress admin and wp-login accessible during whole-site protection
  • Send noindex, nofollow and noarchive directives on protected responses

PageProtectPro Pro features

PageProtectPro Pro adds:

  • Parent and child page protection using the same password
  • Custom logo upload for the visitor password screen
  • PageProtectPro branding removal

Common uses

  • Password protect a WordPress website while it is under construction
  • Create a private client review website
  • Restrict access to staff pages and internal resources
  • Protect company policies, manuals and training pages
  • Share private project or event information
  • Keep a staging or development website away from public visitors
  • Create a simple private content area without a membership plugin

How it works

  1. Open Settings > PageProtectPro to configure whole-site protection, role bypass and the visitor lock screen.
  2. To protect one page or post, open it in the WordPress editor and use the PageProtectPro panel.
  3. Enter a password, enable protection and save the page or post.
  4. Test the protected content while logged out or in a private browser window.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for PageProtectPro.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open Settings > PageProtectPro for whole-site protection and lock-screen settings.
  6. Open any page or post to configure individual password protection.
sections.faq:
Can I password protect my entire WordPress website?

Yes. Whole-site password protection is included in PageProtectPro Lite. WordPress admin and wp-login remain accessible so authorised administrators can continue working.

Can I password protect individual WordPress pages and posts?

Yes. PageProtectPro Lite can protect unlimited individual pages and posts, with a separate password available for each one.

Can I password protect a parent page and its child pages together?

Yes, with PageProtectPro Pro. The Pro version adds parent and child page protection using the same password.

Can logged-in users bypass the password screen?

Yes. You can select the WordPress user roles that are allowed to bypass protection while logged in.

Can I customise the password screen?

PageProtectPro Lite lets you change the title, message, password label, button text, background colour and button colour. Custom logo upload and branding removal are Pro features.

Does PageProtectPro tell search engines not to index protected content?

Yes. Protected responses include noindex, nofollow and noarchive directives. These directives tell compliant search engines not to index the protected response.

Does PageProtectPro protect files that can be opened directly by URL?

PageProtectPro protects WordPress page and post content and can place the public-facing website behind a password. A media file that remains directly accessible by its own URL may require separate file or server-level protection.

Do I need a membership plugin or user accounts?

No. PageProtectPro is designed for straightforward shared-password access. Role bypass is available for selected logged-in WordPress users.

Is this the free version?

Yes. The plugin listed here is PageProtectPro Lite. Parent and child page protection, custom logo upload and branding removal are available in PageProtectPro Pro.
